name: flowfeed
description: Real-time macro, forex and crypto news for AI assistants: Bloomberg, the FT, 8 central banks, US statistics agencies, 20+ newsrooms, the economic calendar and official central bank releases. Hosted remote server (OAuth), paid plan ($9/month).

http.description: Hosted remote server (Streamable HTTP). Sign in with OAuth using your FlowFeed key.

examples.title: Morning macro brief
examples.prompt: What moved forex markets overnight? Use FlowFeed.

examples.title: Central bank releases
examples.prompt: Show the latest ECB and Fed press releases.

examples.title: Economic calendar
examples.prompt: Which high-impact US data comes out this week?
